Book correction: The answer key prints 126.9^\circ, 74^\circ, 106^\circ, 53.1^\circ. The angles at B and C are wrong: \tan B = -4 gives B = 104.0^\circ (obtuse) and \tan C = 4 gives C = 76.0^\circ. Since AB \parallel DC, B + C must be 180^\circ, and 104.0^\circ + 76.0^\circ = 180^\circ. Correct: 126.9^\circ, 104.0^\circ, 76.0^\circ, 53.1^\circ.
